Phishing email alert: We are aware of a phishing email that falsely claims to be from the Supreme Court.
It includes a link “GOV.NZ-COURTLETTER0126.PDF”. This has not been sent by the Supreme Court, or the Ministry of Justice. Delete the email. Do not reply or click on links.

— Courts of New Zealand (@CourtsofNZ) January 26, 2022
